responsibility: Declares low-level REAL/string conversion and validation services for the ISO library. It defines the scanner entry point and conversion-result type alias used to classify real-number text, operations to validate and parse REAL values, helpers that report the output length of floating, engineering, and fixed formatting, and a module-specific exception-status query for conversion failures.
same_name_distinction: This .def file declares the low-level REAL conversion API: scanner entry point, conversion-result type alias, validation/value routines, formatted-length queries, and exception-state test. Its companion RealConv.mod contains the actual finite-state scanner, strtod-based conversion, and formatting-length implementation.
